title: Moment estimates for chaoses with regular moment growth
summary: We give two-sided moment estimates for decoupled chaoses of any order generated by independent symmetric random variables with regular moment growth: $\|X\|_{2p}\le K\|X\|_p$ for every $p\ge1$. The estimates involve only the coefficient tensor and the one-dimensional tails. They use the partition norms of Adamczak and Latała, with constants depending only on the order and on $K$. The proof starts with log-concave tails. Gaussian smoothing gives the estimate for the expected norm needed for induction, and a product comparison reduces the remaining distributions to this case.
